build_EScAIP_backbone: build an EScAIP backbone model for molecular graph attention-based interatomic potential predictions
create_EScAIP_energy_head: create an EScAIP energy head to predict scalar energy from backbone graph features
create_EScAIP_direct_force_head: create an EScAIP direct force head to predict atomic forces from edge and node features
create_EScAIP_gradient_energy_force_stre: create an EScAIP gradient-based head to compute energy, forces, and stress via autograd
review_EScAIP_compiled_forward: review the EScAIP backbone compiled forward pass with transformer blocks and readout layers
